features.title: Private and Reliable Notifications
features.description: Durable, private and lifecycle-correct notification behavior across direct, inbox and opaque push paths.

behaviors.title: Foreground same-chat suppression
behaviors.plainDescription: If you are already looking at a chat, a new message appears there quietly. The phone does not show a notification, play a sound or vibrate.
behaviors.requirement: While chat A is exactly frontmost and the app is foreground-active, update A visually without an OS notification, notification sound, vibration or app haptic. The visual update is the only current cue, and read follows the adopted local predicate.

anchors.rationale: Owns the fresh foreground and exact-conversation decision authority.
Coordinates direct-message presentation outcomes.
